page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the right margin (Spelman, Gamalis); running head at top; page number top right; signature "Gg" and "Sax." at foot.

main_text.p: {a}Gerlbtnaffis, Refectionis] Non multum abit à Saxon. ʒeꝑ eoponyƿƿe, illo senfu accepto.

{b}Gesceudɒt, Confufi] Hoc Saxon. ʒeꝛcynꝺe, ut & dedecus eis ꝑconꝺe. Hinc forte nostratium ꝺhent, & ꝺhen-Spelman, in voceꝺing, (ge, particula verborum præteri-Gamalis,tis, & participiis præteriti temporis apud Saxones & Germanos præposita, hic omissa) quæ proprie increpationem notat: ab increpatione autem oritur confusio. Vide Verstegan.verb.scende, & Kilian. in schanꝺe.
{d}Gesisse, Visione] Hoc Sax. ʒeƿƿe, ab eorum ʒeƿeon fluens, quod videre sonat. Visio autem & Visus nobis hodie sight.
{e}Gefcatbot, Condemnatus: an proprie Mulctatus?] Vide Scatban sal.
{f}Getelt, Tentoria] Hoc Sax. ʒeƿelꝺ; unde nostrum Tilt pro Tentorio.
{g}Getuugel, Linguosus] Talis Sax. ʒeƿinʒe, & ƿunʒƿull; quibus Eloquentia ʒeƿinʒneƿƿe; Lingua; ƿonʒa; ƿunʒel autem iis, astrum, planeta, syꝺus: ƿunʒelcnæpƿ, Astronomia, &c.

page.notes: Marginal reference marks and some Saxon words are uncertain; the Old English glosses were transcribed approximately. The left-margin marks and the small marks at the right are not all legible.
